Title: Output voltage
Requirement Text: The LRU shall hold the output at 28 V +/-1 V over the full load range.

Title: Inrush current
Requirement Text: The LRU shall limit inrush current to 10 A.
Rationale: Derived from the PSSA to protect the upstream bus.

Title: Shutdown on overcurrent
Requirement Text: The LRU shall shut down within 5 ms of an output current above 12 A.

Title: Voltage loop
Requirement Text: The software shall close the voltage control loop every 2 ms.

Title: Overcurrent fault
Requirement Text: The software shall declare an overcurrent fault within 1 ms of the measured current exceeding 12 A.

Title: Power-on built-in test
Requirement Text: The software shall complete the power-on built-in test before enabling the output.
Rationale: Needed to detect a failed current sensor before the output is live.

Title: Housekeeping report
Requirement Text: The software shall report output voltage and current on the maintenance bus once per second.
